mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW M5 owner reports King thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, and says King technical support confirmed the 2024 main bearings were out of spec. Credible single defect report with a dimensional claim attached.
